## About
K L Contractor Plumbing Inc is a locally owned and operated plumbing company based on Olde Towne Pkwy in Marietta. We work on homes and businesses across Marietta and nearby towns like Kennesaw, Roswell, Smyrna and Woodstock.
The company was started because too many homeowners were stuck with unclear pricing, missed appointments and rushed jobs. So we keep it simple. Our prices are upfront with no hidden fees, our licensed plumbers show up on time, and we explain every step.
Whether it's a small leak, a major repair or a new installation, every job gets the same care. Our neighbors have given us a 4.9 rating across 77 Google reviews.

## Services
- Drain cleaning: When a sink or toilet backs up, we come out fast to clear it, with same-day service in most cases.
- Water heater repair and installation: Repair, installation and replacement of water heaters for homes and businesses.
- Emergency plumbing: Emergency plumbing help around the clock, 24/7.
- Sump pump repair: Sump pump repair, installation and maintenance for homes and businesses.
- Kitchen plumbing: Kitchen plumbing repairs and installations, from leaking faucets to clogged drains and garbage disposals.
- Water line repair: Repair and replacement of damaged water lines for homes and businesses.
- Gas line work: Gas line installation, repair and maintenance around Marietta.
- Leak detection and pipe repair: Finding leaks and repairing the pipes behind them.
- Bathroom remodeling: Full renovations, plumbing upgrades and fixture replacements for homes.
- Commercial plumbing: Plumbing service for businesses as well as homes.

## FAQ
Q: What if I have a plumbing emergency after hours?
A: For after hours or holiday service, call our main number at 404-637-2796 and you'll reach an emergency on-call technician.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We're based in Marietta and serve the surrounding area, including Acworth, Holly Springs, Kennesaw, Milton, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Smyrna, Vinings and Woodstock.
